comments.content: The accumulation of `totalTokenUsage.Prompt` and `totalTokenUsage.Completion` was removed and replaced with timing fields only. This means the non-streaming completion response will now always report 0 prompt/completion tokens. Restore the original `totalTokenUsage.Prompt += tokenUsage.Prompt` and `totalTokenUsage.Completion += tokenUsage.Completion` lines in addition to the new timing accumulations.
